fusions.name: Stolen Mouthful
fusions.desc: A quick bite that deals 4 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Mow the Rows
fusions.desc: Crops everything within 3 tiles ahead of you for 7 damage and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Warren Supper
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Fuel for Running
fusions.desc: Whenever you are healed, you restore 6 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
